Onsight

The official design system of the International Slackline Association (ISA). Version 0.18.0.

The decisions first (colors, logos, fonts, spacing), then live examples of every component, built from the same CSS that projects install. Press Tab to see focus rings.

Principles

The decisions every ISA website and web app follows. Details and reasons: AGENTS.md and DECISIONS.md.

  • One source. Colors, fonts and sizes are defined once, as tokens, in this repository. Projects use the named roles, never their own values.
  • Readable for everyone. WCAG 2.2 AA at least: text contrast 4.5:1, a visible focus ring, links underlined, meaning never by color alone.
  • Phones first. Every screen works at 360px wide. Anything tappable is at least 44px.
  • Two fonts. Barlow Condensed for headings, Barlow for everything else. The same two for print and slides.
  • Light and dark. Every role has a light and a dark value. A project opts in to dark mode and offers a switch.
  • Reuse before you create. Use the components on this page. A new pattern is a decision for people, not for an agent alone.
  • Real HTML. Real buttons, links and labels; one main area and a skip link on every page.

Brand colors

The three official colors (Roberto, 2026-10-27). Brand red and green are for logos, large display text and decoration. For text and buttons the system uses darker steps of the same scales, so contrast is met.

ISA Green#009F9A
ISA Gray#454546

Category colors

For badges and tags (disciplines, levels, roles). Separate from the brand colors. Each is a pair: a light tint and a dark shade, checked for contrast. Each project decides which category gets which color.

redgreenbluetealorangeyellowpinkvioletpurple

Logos

The official logos, in assets/logos/. Use them unchanged: never redraw, recolor or stretch one. They are not covered by the open license.

ISA logo

Default where there is room, wide in headers, minimal for small sizes and icons. Color on light surfaces, white on green and dark ones.

Commission logos

One per commission, all the same shape. Color on light surfaces, white on green and dark ones.

Certification marks

Every logo also exists in black and grey (one-color use).

Rules

  • Color first. Use the color version on white and light backgrounds. White on green, dark and photo backgrounds. Black or grey only for one-color printing.
  • Clear space. Keep at least half the height of the ISA mark free on all sides (about the width of the red "I").
  • Minimum height on screens. Default 64px, wide 32px, minimal 24px, Education and Safety 48px, certification marks 24px. In print 16mm for all.
  • Which shape. Default where there is room, wide in headers, minimal for small sizes and icons.
  • Never recolor, redraw, stretch, rotate, crop or add effects, and never place the color version on a colored or busy background.

Full rules, based on the ISA CD Manual: assets/logos/README.md.

Typography

Two families, both free (SIL Open Font License) and hosted with the system, so pages make no requests to Google.

Barlow CondensedHeadings, 20px and upfont.family.heading
BarlowBody text, labels, buttonsfont.family.body

Screen sizes

Layouts start from the phone and change at: xs 320px, sm 640px, md 768px, lg 1024px, xl 1280px. Content is at most 1280px wide; text pages 720px. Touch targets: 44px.

Color roles

What projects and components actually use: a name for each job a color does. Each role points at a step of the scales under Brand colors, with a light and a dark value. Role names start with color. (for example color.text.muted, in CSS --isa-color-text-muted). Run npm run check for contrast results in every theme.

TextSurfacesBorders and focusButtons and actionsForm fieldsSelected, tables and small partsStatusCategoriesBrand

Text

Colors for words and icons.

RoleLightDarkUse
text.default #29292A #F6F6F6Body and headings.
text.muted #454546 #B5B5B5Secondary text, help text, captions. Still AA on surface.default and surface.subtle.
text.inverse #FFFFFF #FFFFFFText on dark or brand surfaces.
text.link #005F5C #99D9D7Green 700, not 600: links also sit on surface.subtle where 600 falls below 4.5:1. Underline links in body text.
text.link-hover #004845 #BFE7E6
text.danger #8B2617 #F6B3A8Error messages.
text.success #005F5C #99D9D7

RoleLightDarkUse

surface.subtle #F6F6F6 #1F1F20
surface.muted #ECECED #29292A
surface.raised #FFFFFF #1F1F20Surfaces that float above the page: dialogs, drawers, menus, elevated cards. Same as the page in light; one step lighter in dark, where shadows do not show.
surface.inverse #1F1F20 #3E3E3F
surface.brand #005F5C #00302EHeader bars and brand areas with text.inverse on top.
surface.brand-strong #004845 #004845Hover and current-page background inside brand areas.
